bookAppointment.description: Let the agent book appointments in conversation. Connect Google Calendar or Calendly to offer real free slots, or store bookings in Anselio only.
bookAppointment.whenToOfferDescription: Choose when the agent should offer to schedule an appointment.
bookAppointment.departmentsDescription: Departments the agent can book. Use lowercase labels (e.g. sales, support).
bookAppointment.notifyEmailDescription: Optional — get an email when an appointment is booked.
bookAppointment.disabledDescription: Turn on to let the agent schedule appointments in chat and voice.
bookAppointment.noBookings: No appointments booked yet for this agent.
bookAppointment.calendarSourceDescription: Anselio-only stores the booking. Google Calendar and Calendly list real free times and create the event.
bookAppointment.googleAuthorize: Anselio will read free/busy times and create events on the selected calendar.
bookAppointment.timezoneDescription: IANA timezone used for slots (e.g. Africa/Casablanca).
bookAppointment.durationDescription: Length of each booked slot on Google Calendar.
bookAppointment.workingHoursDescription: The agent only offers times inside these hours.
bookAppointment.calendlyPaidPlan: Calendly API booking requires a paid Calendly plan (Standard or higher).
bookAppointment.calendlyAuthorize: Anselio will list Calendly availability and create invitees for the selected event type.

collectLeads.description: Let the agent capture contact details in conversation and save them as structured leads. Conversational only — no inline form UI (unlike Custom form).
collectLeads.whenToAskDescription: Choose when the agent should request contact details.
collectLeads.name: Name
collectLeads.notifyEmailDescription: Optional — get an email when all required fields are captured.
collectLeads.disabledDescription: Turn on to configure how the agent collects contact details.
collectLeads.noLeads: No leads captured yet for this agent.

customButton.description: Add quick-action buttons above the chat input. Use links for external pages or preset messages to start a conversation topic.
customButton.disabledDescription: Turn on to add buttons above the chat composer.
customButton.buttonsDescription: Shown above the chat input. Link buttons open a URL; message buttons send preset text.

customForm.description: Build a form customers fill in chat. Show it automatically after a number of messages or let the AI offer it with a tool.
customForm.disabledDescription: Turn on to configure a form for web chat.
customForm.descriptionHelp: Optional helper text shown above the form.
customForm.whenToShowDescription: Control timing and whether the AI can offer the form.
customForm.notifyEmailDescription: Optional — get an email when a customer submits the form.
customForm.fieldsDescription: Add inputs customers will fill in the form.
customForm.noFields: No fields yet. Add one to get started.
customForm.label: Label
customForm.addFieldsPreview: Add fields to see a preview.

escalations.description: Hand conversations to your team when customers need a human. Tickets are stored in Anselio for your inbox.
escalations.triggersDescription: When should the agent offer or perform a handoff?
escalations.customerMessageDescription: Shown in chat when a conversation is escalated. Optional.
escalations.ticketsDescription: Configure automatic ticket creation in your inbox.
escalations.allowTicketTool: Let the bot use create_ticket during chat
escalations.requireEmailDescription: Skipped when no email appears in the conversation.
escalations.disabledDescription: Turn on to configure when conversations escalate and how tickets are created.

suggestedMessages.description: Show quick-reply chips in chat. Static starters appear before the first message; dynamic suggestions refresh after each bot reply when enabled.
suggestedMessages.starterMessagesDescription: Quick-reply chips visitors can tap to start a conversation.
suggestedMessages.disabledDescription: Turn on to configure starter chips and dynamic suggestions.

validation.duration: Duration must be between 5 and 240 minutes.
validation.workingHours: Add working days and an end time after the start.
validation.messageLength: Preset text must be 200 characters or less
validation.selectOption: Select fields need at least one option
